reviews.author: Vincent Jones
reviews.text: Stumbled upon this club a few months ago as a beginner to chess. This environment has allowed me to forge deep, enriching connections, and I continue to build more every week.

reviews.author: Anton Pham
reviews.text: Harold, the organizer, is super friendly and really gives great insights on how to play chess well! His lessons are super useful and I have used them to win many chess games! I highly recommend joining this chess club if you’re interested on playing chess!

reviews.author: joylove
reviews.text: The chess club here has been open quite a long time and it’s pretty vibrant with people. They’re all welcoming to all levels and and helpful with many pro tips.

reviews.author: Alex Galante
reviews.text: Solid chess club with relaxed, beginner-friendly vibes and good organization/leadership.

reviews.author: Brandon Vila
reviews.text:
Kava Social Chess Club brought me some of my most memorable experiences in all my years of playing chess. Harold, the leader of the club, is very welcoming towards players of all levels—including beginners—and always has club activities year round that accommodates everyone. I’ve had the privilege of giving a lecture and simul at the club, and Harold was very easy to work with to get these events going.

My only complaint is that when the club runs during the night, there’s no decent artificial lighting besides some dark neon lights (as seen in photos), so it gets difficult to play while trying to see the game, but this may have changed since I last went. This is more of a minor complaint from me, but others may find it more irritating.

Overall, still a great club to be a part of if you’re in the Sarasota area!
